notes.title: Cavity Busters Update 41 patch 2-6 and Important changes to saving a run
notes.notes:
Yooo. You've probably noticed the game updated a couple times over the past few days. They were super minor changes but have since snowballed into something worth posting about.

Saving Changes
So honesty time (not really honesty, ya'll knew this already.). When I made Cavity Busters, I was really bad at making games. I still am but not really bad. There are things that I just can't fix without completely remaking the game. I'm committed to fixing any game crashing bugs that are sent my way. But game crashes still suck. And so, if they happen during a run now, the game will save your run so that you can continue from the start of the level where the game crashed. So at most you'll lose maybe a couple minutes rather than an entire run. There's some limits to this. It won't save on the first level because like... what's the point. And the save will not be seeded so you will play the same level but it will be completely random from the state of the game when it crashed.

But still, please post crashes! That's all! Thanks for playing!

Peace
Space

notes.title: Cavity Busters Update 41 - Tipping the Scales... and cleaning em a bit
notes.notes:
Hey all! I wanted to get this out yesterday but day time job took up my time so here we are.

This update is about balance. Cavity Busters is a two toe experience. The first toe is about getting tons of upgrades and walking into a room and Thanos toe snapping your enemies out of existence. But the other toe - probably the little toe that doesn't get enough attention, and starts to grow a weird nail, but also where is the nail? - is about intricate hand crafted bullet patterns. This manifests pretty well in early levels, but by the late game, you barely see enemy bullets. So this update introduces a toe I mean, an game mode to push that feeling into late game content.

(Why toe analogy for game about teeth.)

Balance Mode
First and foremost, this mode is completely optional. So getting completely OP and decimating bosses as soon as you enter the room is unchanged. High five? High five! But with toes. Glob, stop.

Ok, so balance mode does make things a bit more difficult. First of all, enemies all have a slight damage cap. I promise this isn't too aggressive. There's a nice balance of letting bosses show you the cool bullet patterns they have while crushing them with your over powered build. The next thing is, most upgrades will require some sort of payment to pick up. For instance, you may need to part with some health or mints.

What Else
I have to admit. A lot of the stuff that's getting fixed or changed, should've been done back when I was in full development of this game. But I think I burned out back then. So I'm fixing things that have bothered me for years. The changes below are listed in order of coolest. At least I think they're cool.

Additions and Changes

 added a game mode that balances out the game for a slightly harder but fair experience
 harvesting crops now saves rewards so you can exit or switch characters without losing anything. Then you receive the rewards at the start of your run
 changed background art on tutorial rooms
 auto aim for controller is much better now
 added a hp bar to shard crystal fight
 added some feedback and sound fx for when you can't do certain actions like healing or jumping or purchasing an item
 added a little effect after beating a round to show stars achieved
 added some ui to show items that effect active healing
 when wall bashing into an enemy, you have a bit more control over your gummy while in the air
 Necrotizing Fasciitis and Deadly Needle chance of firing have been reduced again and made it so they can't insta kill bosses or mini bosses
 lowered crit tickles chance for crit hit
 changed double damage bullets color slightly
 updated game modes sprites color
 poison wont affect player in jack npc room now
 parasite upgrade does a bit more damage now
 embrybro and squeezy toy are no longer tied to active heal use. i mean squeezy toy is, but also to other things
 key bindings should now properly load for each save profile
 mega drill draws over the top of walls when it's available to use
 when wall running duration runs out, gummy will hop off the wall more smoothly
 lowered the default starting sound and music on a new save file
 lowered the default screen shake amount on a new save file
 completion stars a bit smaller on upgrades on the ground
 sneeze diseases will not move towards the player while transitioning to new levels and looping


Fixes

 fixed a crash that would happen when you had the face mask
 fixed a bug where orby gummy could use shot gums without using goop
 fixed a number of bugs where the sound fx would get really loud
 fixed pick up item text being all over the screen in bigger rooms
 filling monster will push out of walls and holes better
 spikey monster won't spawn on top of exchange monster
 fixed an infinite goop exploit
 i think i fixed a couple door bugs - i think


And that's it! Remember to leave a review! I really gotta get back to working on Gum Flesh but I'll be around to fix bugs and probably do some more balancing.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2946900/Gum_Flesh/

Enjoy!

notes.title: I don't know why but... UPDATE! Trading Cards, Boss Rush, and Synergies!
notes.notes:
Welcome to another update that started out as a little bug fix patch and grew into much more. This isn't a huge update by any means, but big enough to warrant a little fanfare.

Trading Cards
Trading cards! I've always wanted to add trading cards but I had to wait for Steam to grant permission to do so. They require a game to have a certain level of community interaction. Along with trading cards, there's profile badges, profile backgrounds and emotes that are earned by collecting all the trading cards.

Boss Rush
The new boss rush mode serves two purposes.
1. To test your mettle against the Pearly Knights with minimal upgrades.
2. There's a boss that has three different phases and you only get to fight the first two phases once in regular play. So the boss rush lets you fight all three phases. And ya know... it looks good on paper. "Boss Rush". See?

Synergies
New Synergies! Natural occurring synergies are great. But I love synergies that grant a whole new mechanic or boost. So I added 12 more bringing the total to 31!

Tooth Caps
Tooth Caps! These are just cosmetic but honestly, I love adding them. They're easy and fun. Love some good teeth bling.

What's Next
Well is this the LAST update for Cavity Busters!? Who knows. It is for now. (besides the 900 updates I'll do to fix whatever this update broke) I'm working on my new game, Gum Flesh, and I need to get going on that. There's a very early demo available. Go play and wishlist! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2946900/Gum_Flesh/

But anyways. That's all for now. Thanks for playing, for being here. Makin games is fun because of ya'll. Also write a review? 

Peace!
Space

notes.notes:

Grab your tooth and jump back into The Goop Canals! We're here with a massive update!

Hello and welcome (finally) to update 30! It's been over three months since the last update. But it was time well spent and much needed. The game is better for it and I'm less burned out heh :) This update adds so much. I'll go into some detail here about it but if you just want the cold hard changes, scroll down a bit.

[previewyoutube=6TCx0RBz7Bc;full][/previewyoutube]

First and probably what took the most work, The Bestiary. This involved making icons for every single enemy. Long and tedious. Next was creating a way to unlock those entries that was fun and would serve a purpose even after all entries were unlocked. I was working on this even before the three months but I needed a little bit longer to finish it. I wont spoil it here though. You'll have to find it. :) There's still no lore in the entries though. Writing lore is hard. :(

Lets talk about a new mechanic. I know. The game is already bursting at seams with mechanics. So why another one? This one feels really natural and I think it'll contribute to the flow of combat. I call it the Boop. While wall running, perform a wall dash into an enemy and you'll bounce off the enemy, giving you some extra wall dash distance and causing damage to the enemy. I think it's a blast to use. 

Last but not least, two new gummys! Designing gummys is really fun but it's hard work. A new gummy has to work with, not all but most upgrades. And this is the biggest challenge really. In a game where you have so much control over your projectile, it's tough adding in a new character that handles that projectile differently. The first gummy is Denture Gummy. Denture starts with 4 teeth and can fire them individually or fire a large clump of teeth with a charge shot. This gummy is like an easier version of Pre Molar and that's why it'll be unlocked by default. The other gummy is Spider Gummy! But that's all I'll say on that. :)

Thank you for your patience and support. Can't wait to hear what ya'll think of the update. Please consider leaving a review as it encourages us to keep going and nudges Steam to suggest the game to other people. 

Until next time,
Peace!

Open MyDocuments or MyComputer and type this into the top bar: 
C:\Users\ -your user name here-\AppData\Local\Cavity_Busters

There you'll see all the save files. There's a couple different ones so it's a good idea to grab them all. But especially the savedata and upgradedata files. I wouldn't worry about grabbing the run files because those are likely outdated anyways.

Hey everyone! Got another update for ya. In this update we have looping! It's a bit early on at this point but it'll improve the longevity of a run if you feel like continue with the build you have. It'll be unlocked if you've beaten the game already.

New Stuff:

 looping!
 added about 20 new rooms
 added 3 new upgrades


Fixes and Tweaks:

 bowel movements increase each level
 enemy stats are increased a bit in hard mode
 enemies have a cool down after being stunned
 you can now shoot shot gums with the shoot button when NOT holding your tooth
 possible fix for rare cases of items not saving to a room
 decreased spawn rate for stackable items
 items now spawn properly in Isaac mode


As always thanks for playing and please be sure to drop a review as it helps Steam direct others to the game!

Enjoy!

edit: if you loop like an insane amount, I wouldn't be surprised if the game crashes :D

notes.title: Cavity Busters Update v 0.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello all! 

This update is on the smaller side but contains some important little tweaks and fixes :)

New Stuff:


 added about 10 new rooms
 added a new upgrade


Fixes and Tweaks:


 took out hotkey 'Z' for fullscreen
 shot gums will continue to aim if it's still firing even if the button is released
 fixed a bug where the player would take multiple hits of damage when rolling
 the hub areas computer now works with a mouse
 fixed a bug where players tooth would pass through an enemy at close range on charge shots
 enemies stats have a high max increase on leaving diseases
 Diseaple npc can offer up to four diseases
 laser synergy now allows player to keep shooting tooth at lower damage
 laser synergy can no longer be shot at super speeds
 text from upgrades no longer overlap each other
 can no long pick up multiple upgrades at a time causing upgrade info to be missed
 when coming into a room over a hole, the player has a few moments to roll or jump out of danger


and a bunch more!

Be sure to drop a review if your enjoying the game! The feedback helps a ton. :)

Discord

Enjoy!

notes.title: Content Update 2. v 0.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! :) 
We have some cool stuff for you this week on top of a ton of fixes and tweaks.

What's New:

 3 New game modes to unlock
 3 new upgrades to unlock


Tweaks and Fixes:

 upgrades no longer spawn in the tutorial
 fixed typos
 jump was balanced again (you can no longer suck your tooth up while in the air)
 difficulty select was removed from the main menu and added to the hub area
 wall dashed destroy meat lumps out of combat
 magic bean effect lowered greatly
 frozen enemies show if they are stunned
 frozen enemies look more frozen
 some symbols in Dronks room have been changed
 shot gums can now be fired at the start of a roll and the end of a roll depending on when the shotgum button is pressed
 antibody spawn rate has been decreased
 shot gums can be toggled to 1) hold to shot 2) press every time to shoot 3) toggle shooting on and off
 stats will be shown if you decide not to continue your run on death
 added descriptions to some options in the menu


Thanks for playing everyone! I hope you enjoy this update :)
Again I'm open to feedback and suggestions. You can leave that stuff in the usual places.

Discord

Peace!

notes.title: Version 0.0.1 Part 2
notes.notes:
Here's part 2 of this weeks update.

What's new:
This update includes 1 disease, 1 power up and a new synergy to find! The synergy is called Inceptadupliplode. That's your hint for finding it :)

Fixes and tweeks:
-nerfed spiders
-fixed more typos (i went to school. i promise)
-you break meat lumps by rolling into them
-jumps cool down is lot longer in combat
-changed how the in game timer is displayed
-oh and nerfed spiders

That's all for now! Next week we'll have more goodies to give :) Thanks for the super nice reviews!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Cavity Busters 0.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hiya everyone! This update was going to go out tomorrow but I found some urgent bugs that needed attention so I'm doing part now and the other bits tomorrow.

Fixes:

-item descriptions will now show up on items that you've already picked up before
-items need to picked up by pressing the confirm button now
-alt tabbing works properly
-gave wall enemies a reminder prompt
-made wall enemies a bit more menacing 
-laser eye bats have a harder hard attack
-fixed an upgrade that wasnt unlocking
-lasers stop if the enemy that shot them dies
-heart burn no longer flashes when it's been cured
-changed some text in the tutorials
-walls have button prompts and indicators where you can dig
-can't jump into enemies mouths anymore
-there's a limit on digging. 
-changed how induplovis works. only activates when entering a room with enemies
-added a game timer. tap/map button to see
-changed some Seers attacks
-nerfed spiders
-nerfed spiders
-nerfed spiders
-fixed some bugs that crashed the game in the collectibles menu
-upgrades that haven't been picked up before have a higher chance of spawning
-fixed infinite cures from disease man

Tomorrow I'll be adding some goodies! Again, thanks for your support and patience! Also dang, those reviews are super sweet :)

See ya!

notes.title: Version 0.0.0 Hot Fix 4
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Here's another pack of bug fixes plus a few features.

Fixes:
-fixed the big bug that's been reported a lot ( i'm 99% sure it's fixed)
-fixed several bugs tied to frozen upgrades. 
-fixed frozen enemies freezing the game. jerks
-fixed bug that caused the last boss to just die. (easy win) what the heck....
-magic bean a just a bit less magic. the effects are a lot less
-combo meter stops while bosses spawn
-tooth now goes through meat lumps outside of combat
-added timer to bullet hell npc room
-map will open outside of combat when jumping to teleport to rooms
-player no longer takes damage in ending scene
-one of the code numbers to awaken Dronk has been simplified
-added an option to game options to toggle holding dash to start a wall run
-pickups should no longer show up on the map if they aren't there
-fixed an instance where players are unable to shoot tooth
-game pauses when you alt tab
-fixed a few instances of enemies getting out the room

Thanks for your patience as we work through this launch week!! You're all amazing! Also be sure to drop a review and tell everyone how unlike Binding of Isaac this game is ;D

Peace out!
